audience: AI platform engineers who send LLM requests through the Portkey gateway

useCases.title: Track cost, tokens, errors and latency over time
useCases.text: The AI reads a time series for one metric, such as cost, requests, tokens, latency, error rate or cache hit rate. It can scope by virtual keys, configs or metadata.

useCases.title: Compare models, users or metadata by usage
useCases.text: The AI reads analytics grouped by models, users or metadata over a time window. You see which model or user drives the most usage.

useCases.title: Review gateway configs and their routing rules
useCases.text: The AI lists configs (routing, fallback, retry and cache rules) and reads one by slug, including its routing rules.

useCases.title: Check virtual keys, their limits and API keys
useCases.text: The AI lists virtual keys with their provider and limits, and API keys as metadata only. Secrets are never returned.

useCases.title: Review users, invites and admin actions
useCases.text: The AI lists workspace members with roles, organization users and pending invites, and reads the audit log of admin actions.

useCases.title: Log a quality score for a request
useCases.text: The AI writes a feedback record on a request by trace id, with a score, an optional weight and metadata.
